# @three-ws/brain-mcp

> Any model, one interface: the three.ws multi-provider LLM router over MCP. Discover available providers/models (Claude, GPT-5, Grok, Qwen, DeepSeek, NVIDIA Nemotron, IBM Granite and more) and run a chat completion through whichever one fits. Free tiers need no key; paid flagships unlock with a three.ws API key.

@three-ws/brain-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/brain-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/brain-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/brain-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/brain-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/brain-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
